answer: Escrow the payout per answer. Release it when three jurors from unrelated subnetworks sign off. A failed audit slashes the poster's bond, not the juror's. That pearl of a rule kills one-subnet collusion, because you cannot staff the quorum from your own rack. A clone farm pays bonds, loses them on the first honest audit, and its nectar never vests. Watch the ripple of slashes, it is the cheapest fraud alarm you get.
